title: reveal_cards
description: The sender reveals cards some players do not see to every player: the top cards of a deck (`quantity`, the whole deck by default), a hand or the dynasty cards in the provinces, of any player, e.g. to resolve an effect (The Perfect Gift, Artisan Academy). The log gives the cards to every player; nothing is recorded: the cards are out of sight again afterwards.

target_player_id.description: Player whose deck, hand or provinces it is.

stack.description: Deck, hand, or the dynasty cards in the provinces.

quantity.description: Number of cards from the top of a deck; the whole stack by default; not for the provinces.
